notes: 5.44.0 was pointed at the wrong vendor. It shipped the Sharadar connector against Nasdaq Data Link (data.nasdaq.com/api/v3/datatables/SHARADAR/SF1) — the historical distribution channel for this data, not the publisher. Sharadar runs its own API at api.sharadar.com. The owner's key is a sharadar.com key; sent to Nasdaq Data Link it was rejected, and NDL answers HTTP 429 for an unrecognised key, so a wrong-host error arrived wearing a rate limit's clothes.
